note: The 2021 delivery carries its own marker binding outside the reviewed 2020 period; the certificate still matches and states the enumerated 2020 codes.
fails_if: `marker_binding_fingerprints` (source_value_bindings.py) stops limiting bindings to the certificate's dated window, so the 2021 member's Tal marker binding enters the 2020 certificate's fingerprint and the certificate goes stale

sources.description: VALUE defined by the same numbered enumeration in 2020 (member 1001) and 2021 (member 1002); each year delivers a Tal descriptor row, a recognized marker, not a code list.
